quarterly_data.quarter: Sterlite Technologies press release: STL launches Plenum-rated Fiber Trunk Assemblies for AI (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: STL launched plenum-rated (OFNP, NFPA 262) versions of its 48 to 576F Intermittently Bonded Ribbon (IBR) pre-terminated cable assemblies for indoor hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data-center pathways; the company says it is now among the global AI-infrastructure providers with NFPA 262-qualified indoor cable assemblies.
